helpPage.title: Allow notifications for this application
helpPage.lead: If notifications are blocked, change the setting in your browser for this site. When you are done, open Account Settings again and use Check again next to Notifications so we can refresh the status.

chrome.title: Google Chrome (desktop)
chrome.body: Click the lock or tune icon in the address bar, open Site settings, find Notifications, and choose Allow. You can also open Chrome Settings → Privacy and security → Site settings → Notifications and allow this site.

edge.title: Microsoft Edge (desktop)
edge.body: Click the lock icon in the address bar → Permissions for this site → Notifications → Allow. Alternatively use Edge Settings → Cookies and site permissions → Notifications.

firefox.title: Mozilla Firefox (desktop)
firefox.body: Click the lock icon in the address bar → Clear cookies and site data → Manage more settings, or open Firefox Settings → Privacy & Security → Permissions → Notifications → Settings, and allow this site.

safari.title: Safari (macOS)
safari.body: Safari → Settings → Websites → Notifications. Find this site and set it to Allow. On some versions use Safari → Preferences → Websites → Notifications.

mobile.title: Chrome or Safari on a phone or tablet
mobile.body: Open the browser menu, find Site settings or Website settings for this site, and enable notifications. On iOS, you may also need to allow notifications for the browser app in the system Settings app.
mobile.chromeAppNote: If notifications still do not appear on your phone, Chrome notifications might be disabled for the whole app in system settings. Make sure Chrome app notifications are enabled.
